# Resetting Your Password

Choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in screen and enter the email address on
the account. The reset link stays valid for 60 minutes and works only once.

A new password must be at least 12 characters long and contain a digit, and
the previous 5 passwords may never be reused.

Five failed sign-in attempts lock the account for 15 minutes. Where two-factor
authentication is switched on, the reset link asks for the six-digit code too.
